assessment: B — independent detector and persona evidence

detector.scope: target file only; no transitive imported-component coverage

overlay.reason: Browser tool exposes read-only Playwright evaluate; mutable title/script preflight is not supported. No live server started or user-visible overlay claimed.
overlay.fallback: CLI detector, DOM/AX inspection, actual keyboard interactions, saved native screenshots

findings.title: Comparison context is lost when revisiting a horse
findings.trace: Selected Sample horse 1, Feeding changes, Last 30 days. Clicked Stable overview and then Sample horse 1. The period remained Last 30 days but comparison reset to Weight & training. Reload returned to stable overview and Last 90 days.
findings.fix: Preserve subject/range/preset/context in route search or stable-scoped view state; preserve comparison selection per horse across scope switches.

findings.title: Scope buttons discard keyboard focus
findings.trace: After activating Stable overview, and again after activating a horse-name row button, accessibility focus became WebArea/body because the focused button unmounted. Combobox keyboard selection retained focus and worked.
findings.fix: Move focus to the persistent scope selector or newly selected section heading after button-driven scope changes; preserve selector focus on combobox-driven changes.

passes: Keyboard autocomplete: enter horse name, ArrowDown, Enter selects the horse.
Chart marker Space activation selects its source record; aria-pressed state and a polite live selected-record region are present.
Mobile Inspect selected records transfers focus and scroll to inspector. Back to chart returns focus and scroll to chart container.
390px viewport has document scrollWidth 390. Inspected weight marker hit regions measured 54x184 CSS pixels; close training marks cluster into an inspectable 2 nearby marks control.

Invalid reversed range hides results and shows plain-language date-order/ten-year guidance. Date fields have aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby referencing the error. Choosing Last 30 days restores chart.
Show 4 weeks before and after offers Return to previous range and restores it.
Unmatched search shows No matching horse or stable as status. Escape restores selected stable and focus to selector.
Empty stable provides Add a horse action and explains how to get records into the period.
sourceOnly: Live comparison loading uses role=status; query failure uses alert plus Retry button (HorseComparisonExplorer.tsx:302). Network failure not injected.

SourceLink routes training/events to entity pages; health to horse care with careView=health; other records to nutrition. Individual non-event record ID is not included in destination, requiring user recognition of source record. Source links are deliberately hidden for comparison sample data, so fixture cannot validate live destination/back flow.
limits: Fixture data, not authenticated backend data

Date fill alone failed to dispatch React change in IAB; subsequent native ArrowUp produced real invalid-range behavior. The fill discrepancy is tooling evidence, not an application finding.
